content_points: Invoice of AED 180 for the mobile line, due 2026-09-25, is 21 days overdue.

To avoid suspension of the mobile line, pay the overdue amount. The payment deadline and any planned suspension date and time are to be filled in from the approved dunning schedule; none is stated in the clauses available here.
Consequence of not paying: the mobile line may be interrupted or disconnected.
Emergency numbers stay reachable during the dunning phases before final disconnection.
If you already paid (you reported a payment on 2026-10-14), we will check it against your account. Please send the payment reference.

proposals.quote: be preceded by an individual notice and appropriate warning to the Subscriber
proposals.rationale: No warning has been sent (warning_sent is false), so immediate suspension is premature. Any interruption must be preceded by an individual warning where possible [22.1.1] that states the actions needed, the due dates and the consequences [22.2]. Any interruption must also be confined to the service concerned as far as technically feasible [22.1.2]. Only the mobile line is unpaid, so the broadband must not be suspended. Contract term 14.2 (suspension without prior notice) does not override these obligations. Emergency-number access must be kept [22.4].
